intro.h2: Painting and carpentry in Stamford from a crew customers call back
paragraphs: MS Home Improvement LLC is a construction company led by Marco, and the strongest thing our reviews say is that people keep calling us back. One customer has had us paint her house inside and out, build a greenhouse shed and redo her basement. Another has hired Marco for numerous projects, from indoor and outdoor painting to intricate carpentry.

Painting is the work customers mention most, but our photos show what else happens on our jobs: floor-to-ceiling built-in shelving with cabinets below, and a gray garden shed with a clear roof and a Dutch door. Customers describe the work as professional, clean and on time, and the pricing as very fair.

about.h2: About Marco and MS Home Improvement
about.text: MS Home Improvement LLC is a construction company led by Marco, who works with his crew in and around Stamford, CT. The work is broad: interior and exterior painting, intricate carpentry and built-ins, basement remodels and backyard structures such as a greenhouse shed. What ties it together is how customers describe us: responsive, trustworthy, professional and clean, with prices one customer calls very fair. Both of our Google reviewers have hired us for several projects, and that kind of repeat work is what we aim for. We are open Monday through Saturday.
about.owner_role: Named in both Google reviews as the person who leads the crew; last name and title not stated

image.alt: Back of a cream clapboard colonial with a brick chimney and a white-railed porch above a covered patio

process.h2: How a project with us works

steps.title: Call us
steps.text: Call (203) 241-6761 any day from Monday to Saturday and tell us about the painting, carpentry or remodeling you have in mind.

steps.title: Look at the job
steps.text: We look at the rooms, walls or yard with you and talk through materials, colors and what the finished project should look like.

steps.title: A fair, clear price
steps.text: You get a price before work starts. Customers say Marco prices his work very fairly, with no guesswork about the cost.

steps.title: Clean, on-time work
steps.text: The crew works professionally, keeps your home and yard clean along the way and finishes on time, as our customers describe it.

steps.title: Walk through it together
steps.text: We look over the finished work with you before we leave, so you can point out anything you would like adjusted.

service_area.h2: Painting and carpentry in Stamford, CT
service_area.text: MS Home Improvement LLC works with homeowners in Stamford, CT. Our Google listing does not show a street address or a list of towns yet, so if your home is nearby and you are not sure we cover it, call (203) 241-6761. Tell us where you live and what you want done, from painting to a new built-in or shed, and we will let you know.

items.q: What kind of work do you do?
items.a: Painting inside and out is what customers mention most. We also do intricate carpentry such as built-in shelving and cabinets, basement remodels and backyard structures like a greenhouse shed. Call us with your project and we will tell you whether it is a good fit for our crew.

items.q: Can you handle several projects at one home?
items.a: Yes, and many customers do exactly that. One had us paint her house inside and out, build a greenhouse shed and redo her basement. Another has hired Marco for numerous projects, from painting to intricate carpentry. Tell us everything on your list when you call.

Yes. Both of our Google reviews mention outdoor painting, and one customer had her house painted inside and out. We can talk through siding, trim and other exterior surfaces when we look at your home, along with any interior rooms you want done at the same time.

Google lists us as open Monday through Saturday and closed on Sunday. The quickest way to reach us is a call to (203) 241-6761. Tell us a little about your home and the project, and we will set up a time to come and take a look.

items.q: How do you price a job?
items.a: A repeat customer says Marco prices his work very fairly. Every home and project is different, so we give you a price after we have looked at the job and before any work begins. Call us to set up a visit and talk through what you want done.
